prohibitions: Do not run CoreML or model inference until the parent gives an explicit GO and grants the runner lane.
Do not edit shared repository files.
Do not inspect any 204-fixture model output until the candidate, runner, evaluator, and this preregistration are sealed in a new armed revision.
Do not insert stateful-streaming output into the product unless every quality, protocol, and speed gate passes.

baseline.name: shipping_offline_authoritative
baseline.result_start: after the same canonical PCM final sample is committed
baseline.result_end: complete product result delivered by the persistent worker

candidate.name: stateful_sliding_window_during_capture_then_exact_product_vocabulary

window.hypothesis_chunk_note: Present in the API but unused by the pinned SlidingWindowAsrManager processing loop.

required_temp_seams: Inject the exact shipping ASRConfig rather than SlidingWindowAsrConfig.asrConfig defaults.
Persist and pass each fixture's explicit Language to every transcribeChunk call.
Return a detailed final value with raw token IDs, token strings, absolute timestamps, durations, confidences, failed-window count, and processed-window count.

Do not enable SlidingWindowAsrManager's confirmed-window vocabulary path. Run OpenRamble's exact final candidateRegions CTC scheduler and rescorer once over the complete canonical PCM using the final candidate TDT text/timings.
Make input buffering bounded and make streamAudio return accepted/dropped/terminated; any non-accepted frame invalidates the candidate.
Make finish close the update stream; make cancel await recognizer-task exit when possible; otherwise kill and reap the exact worker generation before offline fallback.
Create one manager per dictation; never call reset after its one-shot input stream has been finished.

frame_transport.ack_semantics: worker owns an immutable copy in a bounded queue, not inference complete
frame_transport.finish_binding: strict generation + dictation session + stream UUID + contiguous sequence + absolute sample offset + final sample count + SHA-256 of all canonical PCM bytes

short_holdout.distribution: 102 en + 102 ru; exactly 34 in each language x 1-2/2-3/3-4 second bin
short_holdout.status: sealed_before_inference; no model outputs inspected according to manifest and local artifact audit
short_holdout.reuse_rule: The previous preregistration is not authority for this different candidate. Arm a new version before one-shot inference; never tune from these outputs.

long_real.status: previously used engineering data; product-names reference is vocabulary-heavy and must be reported with its provenance caveat

stages.name: cpu_protocol_and_source_gate
requirements: CPU protocol tests pass for happy path, sequence gap, absolute-offset mismatch, stale fence, bounded overflow, and final hash mismatch.
Temp patch and runner compile; exact diff, binary SHA-256, model tree hashes, evaluator hash, and output destinations are sealed.

stages.name: engineering_smoke
stages.fixtures: four real short fixtures, then 14.9/15.1/29.9/30.1 boundaries only if short passes
stages.protocol: one persistent process; symmetric 2 warmups per arm; 3 measured AB/BA runs with fixed seed 0x53545245414d5444; candidate PCM paced at 80 ms; baseline idles during speech and starts at the same stop instant
hard_stop: Any PCM gap, drop, hash/count/fence mismatch, queue overflow, worker crash, stale output, duplicate/missing final, failed model window, or non-reaped cancelled generation.
Any nondeterministic raw text/language/token-ID/token-timing/word/product-text/vocabulary-outcome hash within an arm on a fixture.
Any empty/catastrophic result, invalid token/word structure, out-of-range/nonmonotonic timing, candidate minus baseline word errors >=2, or vocabulary false negative.
Any candidate under-speech inference duty >0.95 or candidate Stop-to-final p95 >= baseline Stop-to-final p95.

stages.name: one_shot_204_quality
stages.precondition: Stage 1 passes and a replacement preregistration is armed before opening any holdout result.
stages.protocol: each of 204 fixtures exactly once per arm; fixed randomized paired AB/BA order; same persistent-process prewarm; no exclusions or retries; evaluator writes before any summary is viewed
stages.analysis: paired WER/CER bootstrap with 10000 fixed-seed resamples overall, by language, and by duration bin; raw and normalized transcript hashes; raw token IDs/strings/times/confidences; words; vocabulary outcome; Stop-to-final; under-speech duty; peak RSS

stages.name: latency_and_long_confirmation
stages.short_latency: fixed 12-fixture stratified subset, 2 per language x duration bin; 2 symmetric warmups; n=20 paired randomized measurements per fixture
stages.long_quality: one result per arm for each 56.104 s and 84.381 s fixture plus transcript/token/timing/word/vocabulary hashes and WER
stages.long_latency: one symmetric warmup then n=5 paired randomized measurements per arm per fixture
stages.resource_checks: peak and post-session RSS, queue high-water samples, under-speech model-call wall/union duty, backlog at Stop, FD count, worker PID/generation, cancellation/reap, thermal state

fallback.authoritative_audio: The existing lossless CapturedRecording.samples buffer remains complete and is never replaced by the speculative queue.
fallback.trigger: Any protocol, queue, model-window, cancellation, quality, or speed gate failure.
fallback.action: Invalidate all streaming output; send streamAbort; wait a bounded 250 ms for cancel-and-join; if not reaped, kill and reap the exact worker generation; prepare a fresh generation; run the unchanged shipping offline path on the complete frozen PCM.
fallback.feature_flag: Default off; one-session lease; disabling it never changes shipping offline behavior.

decision_rule: Integrate nothing from this lane unless all protocol, quality, determinism, speed, resource, cancellation, and lifecycle gates pass. Otherwise retain shipping offline final; optional preview remains eyes-only.
